# Existing-Skill Coverage Prompt

Search explicit local roots first, then authorized current public catalogs or repositories. Compare actual triggers, outputs, workflow, tools, permissions, context architecture, tests, provenance, and maintenance.

Classify each match as exact, extendable, composable, adjacent, or irrelevant. Do not recommend installation from a search snippet alone. Record search terms, date, source, revision when known, and unresolved safety or license questions.
